noisePolicy.rule: Promote ideas and contracts, not raw archive structure.

conversionMap.signal: Low, medium, and high quality presets with capped DPR, particle limits, and fallback requirements.
conversionMap.guardrail: No heavy 3D dependency until static and reduced-motion fallbacks are stable.

conversionMap.signal: Render readiness, motion sustainability, accessibility continuity, asset readiness, and release governance.
conversionMap.guardrail: Signals stay explainable and low-pressure instead of becoming a panic dashboard.

conversionMap.signal: Feature proposals are routed through atmosphere, editorial rhythm, motion restraint, minimalism, and quality gates.
conversionMap.guardrail: New interface ideas must be refined before they become runtime UI.

conversionMap.signal: Portfolio screens are scored for first viewport signal, rhythm, breathing room, mobile spacing, and motion restraint.
conversionMap.guardrail: Aesthetic upgrades must improve clarity, not just visual density.

conversionMap.signal: Cinematic 3D route accepts quality, motion, animation, sequence, panel, and zone modes.
conversionMap.guardrail: Keep 3D as an isolated route before homepage promotion.

nextFeatures.title: Archive Signal Reviewer
nextFeatures.summary: A small review board that turns archive findings into approved, deferred, or rejected feature candidates.
nextFeatures.acceptance: Each candidate has source, value, risk, and rollout status.

nextFeatures.title: Composition Score Panel
nextFeatures.summary: A calm UX review panel for first viewport signal, heading rhythm, breathing room, mobile spacing, and motion restraint.
nextFeatures.acceptance: No score appears without a written rationale and a rollback-safe next action.

nextFeatures.title: Manual Spatial Preview
nextFeatures.summary: A manually activated 3D preview mode that starts as CSS/canvas and only graduates to WebGL when budgets are met.
nextFeatures.acceptance: Reduced-motion and compact viewport users receive equivalent static content.
